matching.value_candidate: a value item for this literal and column lists this stored value

matching.column_candidate: a column item lists this column
matching.table_candidate: the table item lists this table
matching.join_flag: the relationship item reports this join (either orientation) as not declared or with a note
matching.representation_flag: a representation item for this column says it is used numerically but stores text that is not a plain number
matching.unavailable: a database fact no retrieval kind produces; never matched
matching.shown: a fact counts only if its item is in the rendered payload a model would read

classes.partial: some, not all, required facts retrieved
classes.complete: every required fact retrieved: the evidence supports the repair (reasoning may still be needed, listed under other_changes)
classes.unresolved benchmark disagreement: matching the reference needs something the question does not ask for; facts are still reported
